palette_rules: bg is the canvas, fg the text, face the cat and wordmark, cursor the mouth and live marks. Keep face and cursor at 3:1 or better against bg; fg at 4.5:1. Add a palette by adding a row here and rebuilding; the app palettes were derived from web/src/palettes.css on October 11, 2026.
